title: Borrowing a Club During a Round
question: Are you allowed to borrow a club from another player and use it to make a stroke during a round?

choices.text: No, you are not allowed to borrow clubs from other players during a round
Yes, as long as you ask politely
Yes, but only once per round

explanation: You may not borrow a club from another player to make a stroke during your round. Every player must play only with their own clubs.
